summary: Lianhe Sowell International Group Ltd, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting two press releases announcing a 1-for-16 share consolidation of its ordinary shares to maintain its Nasdaq listing. The consolidation takes effect June 22, 2026: every 16 shares become 1, reducing outstanding Class A shares from 52 million to about 3.25 million and Class B from 3 million to about 187,500. Par value changes from $0.0001 to $0.0016. Fractional shares are rounded up. Shareholder approval was obtained May 28, 2026; board approval May 14, 2026. This is a routine reverse stock split for compliance, not a special situation.
